notes:
### New Features
- **Navidrome on Android** - The Rust streaming layer now ships in the mobile build: the source switcher, playback, covers and offline downloads work on the phone, not just the connection check
- **Music folder binding** - One tap in storage settings binds /Music: the library picks up everything in it on launch and on manual rescans, no per-file importing
- **Android update check** - The app checks the release manifest on the phone too; installing opens the APK download and Android takes it from there

### Improvements
- Proxy settings work on Android and apply to Navidrome streaming and downloads on every platform
- Settings no longer show desktop-only switches on the phone: autostart, close to tray and webview zoom are hidden where they can't work
- Storage settings show real folder sizes on Android

### Bug Fixes
- Importing from the Android file picker saves files instead of failing on every track: SAF content:// sources are streamed into app storage rather than path-copied
- Files picked without a name extension (Android media picker) get a real one sniffed from the audio container, so they play back properly
